value.rationale: Two independently motivated uniformity statistics—maximum-spacing extreme and Gini global pairwise inequality—have an exact nonzero finite-size cross-moment and a provably vanishing Pearson correlation with explicit logarithmic rate. The law describes dependence of extreme-event and global-dispersion diagnostics, not a freely selected parameter or routine re-expression of either marginal alone.
